[Section] Experiments ::: Hyper-parameters Tuning
[source_id=49] We ran our experiment looking for the best hyper-parameters by changing learning rate from (0,1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001), weight decay from [$10^{-1}$, $10^{-2}$, $10^{-3}$, $10^{-4}$, $10^{-5}$, $10^{-6}$, $10^{-7}$], batch size from [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128], hidden size from [8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512 1024]. Table TABREF30 shows all other hyper-parameter used in our experiment for both of the dataset.
